C-MESSAGE-ONLY-HISTORY-REWRITE-V2.ApprovalBasis: Owner approved the message-only rewrite in chat on 2026-10-24, explicitly requested removal of Claude attribution, accepted preservation of file trees, tags and existing releases, and instructed execution. This bundle replaces C-MESSAGE-ONLY-HISTORY-REWRITE after its baseline text assertion proved line-wrap-sensitive before implementation began.
C-MESSAGE-ONLY-HISTORY-REWRITE-V2.Summary: Add a deterministic fail-closed lane for one owner-approved message-only rewrite of main, then remove Claude co-author trailers and agreed service wording without changing trees or existing release refs.
C-MESSAGE-ONLY-HISTORY-REWRITE-V2.Problem: Eleven main commits contain Claude Co-Authored-By trailers. The normal gate correctly rejects non-fast-forward main updates and needs a strictly narrower proof path before the approved rewrite.

Goals.Goal: Admit one non-fast-forward refs/heads/main update only when old and new histories have equal commit count, parent topology, trees, author identity/date and committer identity/date, leaving messages as the only allowed difference.
Scan all changed messages through deterministic static, attribution and Gitleaks checks and bind the exact ref update and mapping into candidate identity.
Rewrite the eleven Claude trailers plus the explicitly approved agent/unreviewed, re-seal and Russian-subject wording in one deterministic pass.
Rebase open feature and documentation PR branches onto rewritten main before they may merge.

Constraints.Constraint: No tree, author identity/date, committer identity/date, commit count or parent topology may change.
The push changes only refs/heads/main; tags, releases, other branches and pull-request refs remain unchanged during the rewrite.
Force-push protection is bypassed or suspended only for the verified window and restored with read-back immediately afterwards.
The exact message map and recovery ref remain owner-local and are never committed or pushed.
Gate, tests, docs and M-064/V-M-064 changes land through PR #54 before the rewrite.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Removing any path, secret, QA artifact or GRACE provenance from historical trees.
Moving, deleting or recreating existing tags or releases, or erasing objects from forks, clones, caches or pull-request refs.
Changing product behavior, release automation, versions or train membership in this change.
Changing commit authors, dates or messages outside the approved exact map.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The gate admits a tested message-only main rewrite and rejects changed trees, identities, dates, topology, count, multiple refs, tags, other branches, stale tips and forbidden new-message attribution.
The candidate proves every pair before push; all trees and metadata except messages match and no Claude trailer remains on rewritten main.
The installed pre-push hook scans and identity-binds the actual update; remote main equals the reviewed tip.
Tags/releases retain their identities, protections are restored, and open PR branches are rebased rather than merged from old ancestry.
M-064, V-M-064, safety documentation and tests match the final boundary.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/security -p 'test_*.py'; git diff --check; private isomorphism audit; remote identity, attribution and tag-ref audit
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Green tests, exact private receipt and mapping, unchanged tag digest, zero Claude trailers on main, restored ruleset state and rebased open PR heads.

Assumptions.Assumption: PR #56 supplies deterministic gate v1.9.0; v2.8.2 is separately governed by the existing release contracts after this bundle is applied.
